messages:
Maria Chen: CI red on main after we regenerated poetry.lock — macos-latest job failing in async tests. Anyone seen this? Link: https://ci.redwood.com/job/12345
CI Bot: Build #234 failed on macos-latest — pytest -k "async" — 1 failed, 102 passed. Log: https://ci.redwood.com/job/12345/console
Jamal Ortiz: which test is failing? paste the failing trace pls
Maria Chen: Here's the failing snippet:
```
E       AttributeError: module 'anyio' has no attribute 'open_cancel_scope'
...
tests/integration/test_streaming.py:42: AssertionError
```
Maria Chen: I noticed poetry.lock shows anyio 4.2.0 (was 3.6.x before).
Priya Nair: anyio 4.x removed some compatibility shims that pytest-asyncio/our helper libs relied on. Could be the culprit.
Lukas Becker: Can you run `poetry show --tree | rg anyio` and `poetry lock --no-update` to see what pulled it?
Maria Chen: Ran `poetry show --tree`: `httpx 0.24.0 -> anyio 4.2.0` and `pytest-asyncio` still pinned to older API.
Jamal Ortiz: Seems like httpx bumped transitive anyio. Is this from the lock regen or a direct bump? Did CI regen the lock automatically?
Maria Chen: Lock regen was part of a deps maintenance PR (#4127) merged yesterday.
Priya Nair: Quick triage options:
- Pin anyio to ^3.6 in pyproject and regen lock (fast, risk of breaking httpx expectations)
- Downgrade httpx temporarily
- Patch our async helpers to be compatible with anyio 4 (longer)
Lukas Becker: For quick unblocking, pin anyio to 3.6 in `pyproject.toml` and open a short-lived PR. We can follow up with proper upgrade later.
Priya Nair: I'll open the PR now, will also add a CI matrix entry to run macos-latest locally in my fork.
Maria Chen: Thanks! Assigning to @Priya. Please @me when you have the PR so I can unblock release gating. :thumbsup:
Jamal Ortiz: Also, for deptree/bisect, run `git checkout <commit-before-lock-regen> && poetry lock && tox -e py` to confirm.
Maria Chen: Confirmed repro locally on macos VM with pyenv. Test passes on linux containers. Likely platform wheel difference or macOS stdlib linkage.
Priya Nair: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4182 — pins anyio to ^3.6 and adds a note to the dep PR template. Running CI now.
CI Bot: Build #235 started for PR 4182 — macos job queued.
Maria Chen: Great. If CI passes we'll merge and follow up with a proper upgrade plan.
Lukas Becker: We should also add a quick check in our docs to call out transitive anyio/httpx issues.
Maria Chen: Agreed — adding a follow-up ticket.
